name: Slash
mechanic: A short weapon arc. Restore 4 mana on the first successful hit per cast.

name: Cleave
mechanic: Wide frontal sword sweep; delayed contact at 0.2 seconds.

name: Shield Charge
mechanic: Dash through enemies; one damage event per target per charge.

name: Rallying Cry
mechanic: Recover 25% maximum life and gain 30% damage for six seconds.

name: Echo Strike
mechanic: Lorecasting-unlocked delayed area strike; requires first_echo.

name: Cinder Thread
mechanic: A narrow fire projectile that restores mana on direct hit.

name: Glacial Stitch
mechanic: Pierce up to three enemies, slow 30% for 2s; a second hit within 6s freezes.

name: Arcane Fold
mechanic: Blink to a valid ground point; leave a decoy memory for one second.

name: Ashen Ward
mechanic: Absorb damage for three seconds; can later transform into Ember Aura.

name: Starfall Script
mechanic: Mark a circle and strike after 0.8 seconds; deliberate area denial.

name: Needlecut
mechanic: A fast dual-blade thrust restores energy when it connects.

name: Crossed Wounds
mechanic: Two cuts apply separate bleeds that do not snapshot crit.

name: Smoke Step
mechanic: Dash behind a selected target if the destination is walkable.

name: False Opening
mechanic: A timed evasive stance empowers the next strike after a dodge.

name: Silken Snare
mechanic: Lay a visible wire trap; first enemy triggers a short root.

name: Briar Lash
mechanic: A curving vine strike restores spirit on impact.

name: Rootwake
mechanic: Roots advance along the ground and pin the first cluster hit.

name: Wildbound Leap
mechanic: Leap along an arc and land with a small shockwave.

name: Mending Grove
mechanic: Create a small healing field; leaving it ends its benefit.

name: Stormseed
mechanic: A planted seed bursts into lightning after two seconds.

name: Fletched Shot
mechanic: A deliberate aimed arrow restores focus on a hit.

name: Thornfan
mechanic: Fire a spread; each target takes one full hit and reduced overlaps.

name: Trailbreak
mechanic: Roll away from aim direction and clear minor slows.

name: Hawkmark
mechanic: Mark a single target; the next three aimed shots expose its defenses.

name: Briar Trap
mechanic: A placed trap binds one cluster; bosses receive a slow instead.

name: Oathstrike
mechanic: A measured weapon strike builds conviction on contact.

name: Dawnline
mechanic: A short radiant line crosses the ground and hits once.

name: Aegis March
mechanic: Advance slowly with frontal protection; cannot cast during the march.

name: Witness Vow
mechanic: Bind a visible sigil to an ally or self; heal after a short delay.

name: Cinder Verdict
mechanic: Spend stored conviction on a single impact, without free class procs.

name: Echo Bolt
mechanic: Launch an ancestral echo that restores resonance on contact.

name: Storm Totem
mechanic: Place a destructible totem that pulses three times.

name: Stone Refuge
mechanic: Raise a temporary barrier with a clear durability bar.

name: Ancestor Step
mechanic: Return to a placed ancestral footprint within three seconds.

name: Fault Hymn
mechanic: Crack the ground in a line; knock back small enemies.

name: Lucent Word
mechanic: A clear projectile restores insight on hitting an enemy.

name: Mercy Thread
mechanic: Link to a target and heal while maintaining line of sight.

name: Veilbell
mechanic: A visible ringing circle briefly disorients normal enemies.

name: Dream Passage
mechanic: Travel to a nearby marked point; cannot cross sealed doors.

name: Dawn Sentence
mechanic: A slow, powerful radiant bolt that rewards careful aim.

name: Inkspike
mechanic: An ink projectile restores resolve on enemy contact.

name: Hellchain
mechanic: Attach a visible tether; breaking its radius triggers one damage event.

name: Rot Seal
mechanic: A placed curse deals damage over four seconds; one stack per caster.

name: Borrowed Shade
mechanic: A temporary shade intercepts one hit, then expires.

name: Null Door
mechanic: Step through a short-lived ground portal with a visible exit.

name: Foundation Palm
mechanic: A close strike builds flow on contact.

name: Mountain Break
mechanic: A committed palm impact with a short stun on normal targets.

name: River Turn
mechanic: A curving sidestep repositions around a selected enemy.

name: Stillwater Guard
mechanic: Time a brief guard; a successful block unlocks an active riposte.

name: Mistwheel
mechanic: Spin through a short arc with a readable start and finish.

name: Grave Edge
mechanic: A heavy blade strike builds grave reserve on contact.

name: Blood Tithe
mechanic: Spend a visible portion of current life for a frontal cleave.

name: Winter Bulwark
mechanic: A temporary frost shield slows enemies that strike it.

name: Ossuary Call
mechanic: Raise a brief bone barrier; no permanent minion army at base level.

name: Funeral Advance
mechanic: A slow unstoppable march; ends with a short weapon strike.

name: Seamcut
mechanic: A blade slash builds instability on contact.

name: Folded Edge
mechanic: A narrow projected slash crosses a small gap but obeys blockers.

name: Riftstep
mechanic: Blink a short distance and leave a clearly marked return seam.

name: Eventide Guard
mechanic: A timed guard stores one absorbed impact for the next active attack.

name: Ruin Stitch
mechanic: Join two ground marks with a delayed damaging line.

name: Prism Needle
mechanic: A narrow light shard restores aether on contact.

name: Starflare
mechanic: A bright orb detonates once after a short projectile flight.

name: Refraction Step
mechanic: Slide to a nearby point; the trail is visual and never damages for free.

name: Lifeward
mechanic: Place a ward that heals its nearest injured ally once per pulse.

name: Spectrum Lattice
mechanic: Create three visible prisms that slow enemies inside the triangle.
